extDescription.message: Nulavio built-in components: new tab, search and profile settings, and the dangerous-download warning.

searchPlaceholder.message: Search with your default search engine

filterDisabled.message: uBlock Origin is off. To turn it on: ☰ menu → Add-ons and themes

filterMissing.message: No filter installed (tracking protection still applies)

passwordsNone.message: Browser password manager off and no external manager active

statusNote.message: Read just now from the browser settings. Nothing is sent to Nulavio.

broken1.message: Open the uBlock Origin button and turn it off for this site only. Turn it back on the same way.

broken2.message: Click the shield next to the address to relax tracking protection for this site.

broken3.message: On HTTP-only sites, HTTPS-Only mode asks before continuing; the exception is per site and can be removed in Settings.

footer.message: Nulavio is built on Mozilla's Gecko engine. Nulavio is not affiliated with Mozilla.

footerLimits.message: A browser cannot protect against malware already running on this computer.

warnHeadlineDanger.message: This download was flagged as dangerous

warnBody.message: This file can run programs on your computer. Open it only if you trust whoever published it.

warnDanger.message: Safe Browsing flagged this download as dangerous. We recommend deleting it.

warnDeleteFailed.message: Could not delete the file. It may already have been moved or removed.

warnMissing.message: It may have been deleted, or the downloads list was cleared. If you still need the file, look in your downloads folder.

warnWhy1.message: Installers and scripts (AppImage, .sh, .run, .deb, .rpm, Flatpak and others) run with your account's permissions and can read your files and open sessions.

warnWhy2.message: Nulavio never opens these files by itself and saves them without execute permission.

warnWhy3.message: This browser does not check download reputation with Google. Before opening, check the source and, if the author publishes one, the signature or checksum.

settingsIntro.message: Each section says how far a change reaches: this profile, all profiles or this computer. Nothing is sent to Nulavio.

settingsNeedsBuild.message: These settings need the Nulavio build. In this browser, use Settings → Search.

searchEnginesNote.message: Type an alias such as @ddg before your search in the address bar to use that engine once.

engineSuggestOn.message: On: what you type is sent to $HOST$ while you type.

engineSuggestOff.message: Off: nothing is sent until you search.

engineRemoveBody.message: It leaves your list of search engines in this profile. Engines that come with the browser can be restored in the browser's Settings → Search.

suggestPrivateLabel.message: Also show suggestions in private windows

suggestPrivateNote.message: Only from engines with suggestions turned on above.

addProvidersNone.message: All of them are in your list.

addProviderKagiNote.message: Kagi is a paid service; you sign in on kagi.com.

addSearxngNote.message: Use an instance you run or trust. Nulavio never picks a public instance for you.

addCustomUrl.message: Search address, with %s where the search goes

addOpenSearchNote.message: Nulavio downloads this file once to read the engine's addresses.

err_needs_https.message: Use an https:// address (http:// only for this computer).

err_credentials_in_url.message: Remove the user name or password from the address.

err_invalid_alias.message: Aliases use letters, numbers, dot, dash or underscore (up to 20).

err_alias_taken.message: Another engine already uses this alias.

err_name_taken.message: That name is already in use.

err_suggest_other_host.message: The suggestions address must be on the same site as the search address.

err_last_engine.message: Keep at least one search engine.

err_not_found.message: Not found. The list was refreshed.

err_in_use.message: That profile is open. Close its windows, then try again.

err_is_current.message: Delete the profile you are using from its own page.

err_unexpected.message: Something went wrong. Nothing was changed.

profilesNone.message: Keep banking, work and research apart in profiles: each has its own sign-ins, cookies and history.

profilesIsolation.message: Each profile has its own cookies, history, passwords and extensions. Signing in to a site in one profile does not sign you in to the others.

profilesUnavailable.message: Switching profiles works when Nulavio starts from its menu entry. This window was started with a profile folder (--profile), so it is not available here.

profilesDisabled.message: Profiles are turned off in this browser (browser.profiles.enabled).

profilesSensitiveHint.message: Sensitive sites profile: cookies, site data, history and cache are deleted every time it closes, so you sign in again each time. Web pages cannot install extensions here, and the extensions of your other profiles never see its pages. Add only the password manager you trust, and send bank, health and government sites here with routing rules.

profilesTemplatesNote.message: This template only fills in the name, icon and colour.

profilesDeleteBody.message: This permanently deletes its history, cookies, saved passwords, extensions and settings from this computer. Passwords kept in a password manager such as Proton Pass stay in your vault.

profilesVsContainersBody.message: A profile is a separate browser with its own data and extensions. Containers separate cookies inside one profile, but share its history, extensions and settings.

profilesKeyHint.message: Press 1 to 9 to open a profile. Shortcut: Alt+Shift+P

profilesTemporaryAbout.message: A new, empty profile in its own window, with none of the cookies, history or sign-ins of your other profiles. Everything in it, including extensions and settings you add there, is deleted when you close its last window.

profilesTemporaryMemory.message: Kept in memory only. Deleted when you close its last window.

profilesTemporarySwap.message: Kept in memory, which this computer may write to its swap area on disk. Deleted when you close its last window.

profilesTemporaryDisk.message: Kept in a temporary folder on disk. Deleted when you close its last window.

profilesTemporaryBar.message: Temporary profile: nothing here is kept.

profilesColorMigrated.message: $NAME$ changed from mint to lime. Mint now marks Nulavio actions and active items.

err_invalid_avatar.message: Choose one of the icons offered.

err_invalid_color.message: Choose one of the colours offered.

err_no_window.message: Open a browser window and try again.

err_disabled.message: Profiles are turned off in this browser.

err_unregistered.message: Switching profiles is not available in a window started with --profile.

routing_ask_headline.message: Open this link in another profile?

routingNothingLoaded.message: Nothing has been loaded from this address yet.

routingBadLink.message: This page was opened without a valid web address.

routingAskExplain.message: A link from another app goes to $HOST$. Your rule says to ask before opening it in $PROFILE$.

routingRuleGone.message: This address is on $HOST$, but the rule for it no longer exists.

routingBlockedMissing.message: Your rule sends $HOST$ to a profile that no longer exists. So that it does not open in the wrong profile, Nulavio stopped here.

routingBlockedLaunch.message: Your rule sends $HOST$ to $PROFILE$, but that profile could not be opened. So that it does not open in the wrong profile, Nulavio stopped here.

routingBlockedError.message: Routing could not decide where $HOST$ belongs. So that it does not open in the wrong profile, Nulavio stopped here.

routingIntro.message: Choose the profile a site opens in when you open it from another app or type it in the address bar.

routingAskExplainPage.message: You clicked a link to $HOST$ in a page. Your rule says to ask before opening it in $PROFILE$.

routingInPageHint.message: The link opens in your rule’s profile and the page you were on stays. Never moved: pop-ups, forms, redirects, links inside embedded frames, links within the same site and private windows. Off by default: the page chooses the address, and sign-ins that pass through another site may change profile.

routingInPageLabel.message: Also for links clicked in pages

routingTargetMissing.message: The profile of this rule no longer exists

routingNoRules.message: No rules yet. Create one below, or from the profile selector while a site is open.

routingSiteOpensIn.message: Links from other apps and typed addresses for $SITE$ open in $PROFILE$.

err_invalid_site.message: That site address is not valid.

err_invalid_match.message: Choose what the rule applies to.

err_no_domain.message: IP addresses, localhost and public suffixes need a rule for the exact address.

err_too_many_rules.message: There are too many rules. Remove some first.

routingAskExplainTyped.message: You typed an address on $HOST$. Your rule says to ask before opening it in $PROFILE$.

connectIntro.message: What your desktop offers Nulavio, checked just now on this computer. Checking changes nothing and sends nothing anywhere.

connectCheckFailed.message: This check failed. Nothing was changed.

connect_plasma_browser_integration_not_i.message: Plasma Browser Integration is not installed on this computer.

connect_plasma_browser_integration_manif.message: Its configuration file cannot be read.

connect_plasma_browser_integration_host_.message: Its helper program is missing; reinstall it from your distribution.
Its helper program can be changed by other users; reinstall it from your distribution.

connect_plasma_browser_integration_exten.message: Its helper program does not accept the KDE extension.

connect_plasma_browser_integration_no_se.message: Installed, but no Plasma session is running.

connect_plasma_browser_integration_ready.message: Ready. Install the KDE extension in this profile for media controls and for sending pages to your phone with KDE Connect.

connect_xdg_portals_no_service.message: No desktop portal service is running; Nulavio uses its own dialogs.

connect_xdg_portals_ready.message: File dialogs, screen sharing and opening links go through your desktop. File dialog: $MODE$.

connect_secret_service_no_service.message: No secret storage service is running.

connect_secret_service_ready.message: Provided by $PROVIDER$. Nulavio does not store website passwords there.

connect_default_browser_no_tool.message: xdg-settings is not installed, so the default browser cannot be read.

connect_default_browser_is_nulavio.message: Links from other apps open in Nulavio.

connect_default_browser_other.message: Links from other apps open in $NAME$.

connectMakeDefaultBody.message: Web links you open in other apps will open in Nulavio, following your routing rules. You can restore the current browser here at any time.

connectDefaultSet.message: Nulavio is now the default browser.

connectRestored.message: The previous browser is the default again.

err_no_tool.message: xdg-settings is not installed on this computer.

err_set_failed.message: The desktop did not accept the change. Nothing else was changed.

err_not_applied.message: The change did not take effect; the default browser is unchanged.

err_no_previous.message: There is no previous browser to restore.

err_path_unsupported.message: Nulavio is installed in a folder whose name cannot be used in a desktop entry.

connect_plasma_browser_integration_not_r.message: Installed in $DIR$, a folder this Nulavio build does not read. Builds for Fedora read it; this one was built for /usr/lib.

routingBlockedLocked.message: Your rule sends $HOST$ to $PROFILE$, which is locked. Unlock that profile, then try again.

err_locked.message: That profile is locked. Unlock it first.

err_encrypted.message: Lock this profile first, then delete it.

vaultExplain.message: $PROFILE$ keeps its files encrypted until you unlock it.

vaultExplainLink.message: A link for $HOST$ should open in $PROFILE$, which is locked. Unlock it to continue; the link has not been loaded.

vaultUnlocked.message: $PROFILE$ is unlocked and opening. It locks again when you close its last window.

vaultWrongPassword.message: That password did not unlock the profile.

vaultWrongRecovery.message: That recovery code did not unlock the profile.

vaultRecoveryMalformed.message: A recovery code has 28 letters and digits, in 7 groups of 4.

vaultKeyringUnavailable.message: Your computer login could not unlock it (the system keyring is not available or no longer has the key). Use the password or the recovery code.

vaultRecoveryRequired.message: This profile has no other way to unlock it now. Type its recovery code below.

vaultStorageMissing.message: This computer is missing what protected profiles need (gocryptfs and FUSE, or libsodium). Install them, then try again.

vaultNotLocked.message: It is already open or not protected, so there is nothing to unlock.

vaultNoMasterKey.message: Nulavio has no master key: without one of this profile's ways to unlock it, nobody can open it, including Nulavio.

vaultChoosePasswordHint.message: While the profile is locked, protects its files on this computer and in copies of them. While it is open, programs running as you can read them. A long phrase is best.

vaultAlsoKeyring.message: Also unlock with my computer login (anything running as you can then unlock it)

vaultChooseKeyringHint.message: Opens without a password while you are logged in. Protects copies of the files and other users, not programs running as you.

vaultRecoveryIntro.message: If you forget the password or lose access to your computer login, this code is the only way back in. It is shown only now.

vaultRecoveryKeep.message: Write it down or store it in your password manager, away from this computer.

vaultGroupsDiffer.message: Those groups do not match the code above. Check what you wrote down.

vaultCreated.message: $PROFILE$ is encrypted and locked. It opens after you unlock it.

vaultRelocksWhenClosed.message: Unlocked now. It locks again when you close its last window.

err_wrong_secret.message: That did not unlock the profile.

err_wrong_key.message: The profile's storage did not accept the key.

err_tools_missing.message: The Nulavio tools are missing next to the browser, so protected and temporary profiles cannot be used.

err_storage_unavailable.message: This computer is missing what protected profiles need (gocryptfs and FUSE, or libsodium).

err_no_method.message: Choose at least one way to unlock the profile.

err_busy.message: Files of that profile are still in use. Try again in a moment.

err_rollback.message: The profile's key file is older than the profile (restored from a backup?). Nothing was opened.

err_metadata_tampered.message: The profile's key file was changed outside Nulavio. Nothing was opened.

err_mountpoint_not_empty.message: Unexpected files appeared in the locked profile folder. Nothing was opened.

err_keyring_unavailable.message: The system keyring is not available.

err_keyring_missing.message: The system keyring no longer has this profile's key.

err_helper_failed.message: The Nulavio tools did not answer. Nothing was changed.

err_recovery_code_malformed.message: A recovery code has 28 letters and digits, in 7 groups of 4.

err_no_such_method.message: This profile cannot be unlocked that way.

err_last_method.message: A profile needs at least one way to unlock it.

err_phone_not_yet.message: Connecting a phone is not available yet in this version of Nulavio.

err_failed.message: That did not work. Nothing was changed.

err_bad_request.message: That request was not valid. Nothing was changed.

err_storage_failed.message: The profile's encrypted storage could not be opened. Nothing was changed.

err_wrong_container.message: This key file belongs to another profile. Nothing was opened.

err_damaged_envelope.message: The profile's key file is damaged. Use the recovery code.

err_phone_needs_pairing.message: This phone was connected before a security change and can no longer unlock this profile. Remove it and connect it again.

err_unsupported_version.message: This profile was protected by a newer Nulavio. Update Nulavio to open it.

err_unreadable.message: The profile's key file cannot be read.

err_unlocked.message: Lock this profile first, then try again.

aiWorkspaceBar.message: AI Workspace of $AGENT$ · Level: $LEVEL$. The agent controls this window; its permission requests come to your own window, not here.

aiWorkspaceBarProfile.message: $AGENT$ is using your profile $PROFILE$ · Level: $LEVEL$. The agent controls this window, with your signed-in sessions; its permission requests come to your own window, not here.

aiWorkspaceBarRaw.message: Raw automation: Nulavio does not check or record what happens in this window.

aiWorkspaceBarPaused.message: $AGENT$ is stopped: its next actions are refused. To let it work again, use AI & Automation in Settings, in your own window.

aiWorkspaceBarStopFailed.message: $AGENT$ could not be stopped from here. Use the emergency stop in Settings → AI & Automation, in your own window.

aiRequestOnlyIf.message: Only allow this if you asked the agent to do it. Text on web pages can try to make agents do things you did not ask for.

aiRequestWhereWorkspace.message: In the AI Workspace of $AGENT$, a profile kept apart from yours.

aiRequestWhereProfile.message: In your profile $PROFILE$, with your signed-in sessions.

aiRequestExpires.message: If you do not answer by $TIME$, the request is denied.

aiRisk_critical.message: High risk: this lets the agent do things that can be hard to undo, such as payments, running code or reaching your own data.

aiRisk_warning.message: Caution: this changes pages or sends data on your behalf.

aiRisk_info.message: Low risk: the agent only reads or opens pages; nothing is changed.

aiRequestExpired.message: This request is no longer waiting (it timed out or was answered elsewhere).

aiIntro.message: Agents such as Claude Code or Codex use a separate profile of their own (the AI Workspace), only within the permissions you set here.

aiStopHint.message: Blocks every agent at once, the assistant too (no questions or pages leave), and closes their workspaces. Turn it off to let them work again.

aiStoppedBanner.message: Emergency stop is on: every agent is blocked and their AI Workspaces are closed.

aiDisposable.message: Delete its AI Workspace (cookies, history) when it disconnects

aiConfigOnce.message: This configuration points to the agent's key file in Nulavio; it holds no secret. Nulavio changes an agent's settings only through the button above, after you click it.

aiConfigIntro_claude_code.message: Add this to Claude Code: save it as a file and start Claude Code with --mcp-config <file>, or merge it into your project's .mcp.json.

aiConfigIntro_codex.message: Add this to Codex: paste it into ~/.codex/config.toml.

aiConfigIntro_other.message: Add this MCP server (stdio) to your agent's configuration.

aiActivityHint.message: What agents did and what was refused: tools, sites (address of the site only), times. Never page content or what they typed. Kept 30 days.

aiActivityClearBody.message: The record of what agents did is deleted from this computer.

aiFullControlBody.message: With full control, $AGENT$ does without asking everything the other levels ask about: any action on pages, purchases and payments, account changes, private tabs, the profiles in its list and running scripts in pages. Raw automation is not included: it is a separate option with its own confirmation. If the agent is compromised or makes a mistake, your data and accounts can be affected, and what it already did may be irreversible.

aiRawBody.message: $AGENT$ gets a direct connection (WebDriver BiDi) to the browser of its AI Workspace and may open the browser's internal pages. Nulavio does not check, ask about or record anything done through that connection: your permissions, site list and activity log no longer apply there. The emergency stop, Pause and Revoke still close the AI Workspace. Never available in your own profiles.

aiRawHintOff.message: Off. For your own automation library (Puppeteer, Selenium): a direct connection to this agent's AI Workspace that Nulavio does not check or record. Not part of any level.

aiRawHintOn.message: On since $WHEN$: when the agent uses it, Nulavio does not check or record what it does in its AI Workspace.

aiClientMismatch.message: The program that last used this agent's key does not look like the agent it was set up for. If you did not expect this, revoke it.

aiRevokeBody.message: Its next action is refused and its AI Workspace closes. Actions it already took are not undone.

aiRevokedNow.message: $AGENT$ can no longer use the browser.

aiRemoveBody.message: Removes the agent, its permissions and its AI Workspace (cookies, history) from this computer.

aiResumedNow.message: Agents can work again, within their permissions.

aiLevelHint_restricted.message: For agents you do not know: reads and moves around; asks before clicking or typing.

aiLevelHint_assisted.message: Clicks and types for you; asks before submitting, files, sign-ins and purchases.

aiLevelHint_autonomous.message: Completes tasks without asking; purchases, account changes, scripts and the local network still ask.

aiLevelHint_full_control.message: Everything without asking, including purchases, scripts and the profiles you give it; raw automation stays separate. A compromised or mistaken agent could act on your behalf.

err_expired.message: This request is no longer waiting.

err_workspace.message: Not from the AI Workspace: answer in your own Nulavio window.

err_invalid.message: That was not accepted. Check the name and the sites.

err_full_control_not_accepted.message: Full control needs your explicit confirmation.

err_raw_automation_not_accepted.message: Raw automation needs your explicit confirmation.

aiCap_navigate.message: open tabs and go to addresses

aiCap_cookies_storage.message: read or change cookies and site storage

aiCap_multiple_profiles.message: work in more than one profile

aiCap_local_resources.message: reach this computer, the local network and internal pages

aiCap_debugging.message: use raw automation and the browser's internal pages

aiNotDetected.message: $AGENT$ was not found on this computer, so add the configuration yourself.

aiWizardIntro.message: Nulavio can ask $AGENT$ to add Nulavio to its own settings ($TARGET$) by running this command. Nothing is changed until you click the button.

aiReplaceExisting.message: $AGENT$ already has a server named “nulavio”; it will be replaced.

aiInstalled_connected.message: $AGENT$ now has Nulavio and connected to it.

aiInstalled_configured.message: $AGENT$ now has Nulavio in its settings; it connects the next time it starts.

aiInstalled_missing.message: The command ran, but $AGENT$ does not list Nulavio. Add the configuration below yourself.

aiKeyReplaced.message: $AGENT$ has a new key; the old one no longer works. Nothing changes in the agent's settings.

err_already_configured.message: That agent already has a server named “nulavio”.

err_client_missing.message: That agent is not installed on this computer.

err_client_failed.message: The agent's command did not succeed. Nothing else was changed.

err_unsupported_client.message: Nulavio cannot configure that agent automatically.

aiProfilesLabel.message: Your profiles this agent may use

aiProfilesHint.message: Besides its own AI Workspace. In these profiles the agent uses your signed-in sessions (it also needs “use signed-in sessions”); a profile opens for it only while it is closed in your windows, and never while it is locked.

aiRoutesLabel.message: Sites this agent opens in one of those profiles

aiNoRoutes.message: No routes: the agent opens sites in its AI Workspace.

guardIntro.message: These changes to this profile did not come from Nulavio’s settings or menus since Nulavio last opened it. If you did not make them, undo them.

guardEmpty.message: This profile matches what Nulavio last saw.

guardLimitsSummary.message: What Guard can and cannot do

guardLimits.message: Guard notices changes that tools and common malware leave behind in a profile: extensions, trusted authorities, security modules, programs registered for extensions, managed settings, user.js and settings that protect you. It cannot stop a program running as you from reading your data or from also editing Guard's own record. A protected profile keeps the record encrypted while it is locked.

guardBar.message: Nulavio Guard: $COUNT$ change(s) made outside Nulavio since it last ran.

guardExtensionWhy.message: Extensions can read and change the pages you visit. This one was added outside the browser and is running.

guardExtensionWhyOff.message: Extensions can read and change the pages you visit. This one was added outside the browser; it stays off until you allow it in Add-ons.

guardExtensionChangedWhy.message: It was replaced or turned on outside the browser. Updates normally happen while the browser runs.

guardExtensionRemovedWhy.message: It was removed outside the browser. If you rely on it (uBlock Origin, your password manager), install it again from Add-ons.

guardPrefWhy.message: This setting protects you or decides where your connections and searches go.

guardRootWhy.message: A trusted authority can vouch for any website, so whoever holds its key can read and change your encrypted connections. Keep it only if your organisation or a tool you trust installed it.

guardModuleWhy.message: Security modules are programs loaded into the browser to handle certificates and keys (smart cards, security tokens).

guardHostWhy.message: Extensions can exchange messages with this program; password managers and desktop integrations work this way. If you did not install such a program, delete its file.

guardPoliciesWhy.message: Policies override your settings. They come from Nulavio's own installation or from a policies file an administrator or a program placed; see about:policies.

guardUserJsWhy.message: user.js sets preferences every time the browser starts, over your own choices. Undoing a setting it changes lasts only until the next start; edit or delete the file.

guardSearchWhy.message: Everything you type in the address bar goes to the default search engine.

err_not_undoable.message: This change cannot be undone from the browser.

err_not_watched.message: That setting is not one Guard watches.

err_engine_gone.message: The previous search engine is no longer installed.

err_pref_locked.message: That setting is managed by a policy and cannot be changed here.

exceptionsIntro.message: Sites where a protection is off or relaxed, by you or by the browser itself.

exceptionsEmpty.message: No exceptions: every protection applies to every site.

exceptionsFilterOn.message: uBlock Origin keeps its own list of trusted sites, where it does not filter. Nulavio opens its page and never changes its data.

exceptionsFilterOff.message: uBlock Origin is installed but turned off in this profile.

exceptionsFilterMissing.message: uBlock Origin is not installed in this profile.

exceptionTrackingPrivate.message: Tracking protection off in private windows

exceptionCookieSession.message: Cookies deleted when you close the browser

err_filter_missing.message: uBlock Origin is not active in this profile.

err_invalid_type.message: That exception type is not listed here.

dnsIntro.message: Before opening a site, the browser asks a resolver for its address (DNS); here you choose which one.

dnsChoiceLegend.message: How this profile looks up sites

dnsSystemNote.message: As other programs on this computer do. Your network and its resolver can see which sites you look up.

dnsFallback.message: Encrypted DNS, with the computer's resolver as a fallback

dnsFallbackNote.message: Lookups go encrypted to the resolver below; if it fails, the computer's resolver answers.

dnsStrictNote.message: Never the computer's resolver. While the resolver below cannot be reached, sites do not load (also on networks with a sign-in page).

dnsCloudflare.message: Cloudflare (the browser's default, Mozilla's resolver program)

dnsThirdParty.message: The resolver you choose sees which sites you look up from this profile. Read its privacy policy before choosing.

dnsNowFallback.message: Now: encrypted DNS through $NAME$, with the computer's resolver as a fallback.

dnsChoiceHeading.message: How should Nulavio look up sites?

dnsChoiceBody.message: Site lookups (DNS) go to your computer's resolver now, unencrypted. You can keep that, or send them encrypted to a resolver you choose. Nulavio receives nothing either way.

dnsChoiceBodyEncrypted.message: Site lookups (DNS) are encrypted now by the browser's default for your region (a resolver from Mozilla's program). You can keep that, pick another resolver, or use your computer's resolver, unencrypted. Nulavio receives nothing either way.

err_invalid_choice.message: Choose how this profile looks up sites.

err_resolver_needs_https.message: The resolver address must start with https:// and have no user name or password.

passwordsIntro.message: Choose who saves and fills passwords in this profile; Nulavio never reads your vault.

passwordsBuiltinNote.message: Saves logins in this profile. Set a Primary Password in the browser's settings to encrypt them with a password.

passwordsDisableTitle.message: Back to the browser's password manager?

passwordsDisableBody.message: The browser offers to save and fill passwords again. $NAME$ is not removed and its vault is not touched; you can switch back here.

passwordsInstalledOff.message: Official extension installed but turned off; choosing it turns it on.

passwordsNotInstalled.message: Not installed. When you choose it, Nulavio installs the official extension ($VERSION$, from addons.mozilla.org).

passwordsNativeMissing.message: The KeePassXC app was not found: turn on its browser integration (KeePassXC → Settings → Browser Integration → Firefox).

passwordsNativeOptional.message: The desktop app is not installed; it is only needed to unlock with the app.

passwordsEngineLogins.message: The browser keeps $COUNT$ logins in this profile. They are kept when you switch.

passwordsEngineLoginsNone.message: The browser keeps no logins in this profile.

passwordsEngineLoginsOne.message: The browser keeps 1 login in this profile. It is kept when you switch.

passwordsConfirmedIntro.message: You chose to continue on these sites although they look like a site where you keep a saved login, so Nulavio does not warn about them in this profile. Remove one to get the warning back.

passwordsConfirmBody.message: Nulavio installs the official $NAME$ extension, version $VERSION$, from addons.mozilla.org. The file must match the checksum Nulavio pins and carry Mozilla's signature. The browser's own save prompts then turn off in this profile; logins it saved are kept.

passwordsChosen.message: $NAME$ now saves and fills passwords in this profile.

err_install_failed.message: The extension could not be installed (download, checksum or signature). Nothing was changed.

err_data_missing.message: Provider information is missing from this build.

lookalikeHeadline.message: Check the address before you sign in

lookalikeBody.message: $SITE$ looks like $SIMILAR$, where you keep a saved login. Fake sites copy names like this to collect passwords.

lookalikeContinue.message: Continue and don't warn again for this pair

lookalikeContinueNote.message: Nulavio will not warn again about $SITE$ and $SIMILAR$ in this profile. You can undo it in Settings › Passwords.

lookalikeDismissFailed.message: Your choice could not be saved, so the site was not opened. Nothing was changed.

lookalikeWhy1.message: You focused a password field. Nulavio compared this site's name with the sites of the logins saved in this profile, on this computer; nothing was sent anywhere.

methodsWhy.message: Each method holds the same profile key, encrypted its own way, so any one of them opens the profile. Nulavio keeps no copy and has no master key: if every method is lost, nobody can open the data.

profilesTemplatesNoteAll.message: Templates fill in the name, icon and colour. “Sensitive sites” also deletes cookies, history and cache whenever the profile closes.

profilesSensitiveShort.message: Deletes cookies, history and cache whenever it closes: you sign in to sites again each time. Pages cannot install extensions here.

routingNeedsTwoTitle.message: Routing needs at least two profiles

routingNeedsTwoText.message: Create another profile, such as Banking or Work, and choose which sites open in it.

suggestPrivateOff.message: Turn on the suggestions of an engine above to use this option.

layoutScopeMore.message: Changes apply to the open windows of this profile at once and are kept when you restart. In the browser’s own settings (Browser layout), these choices show under those names.

exceptionsIntroMore.message: Remove an exception and the protection applies to that site again. The site panel in the address bar shows what tracking protection blocked on the page you are on.

dnsIntroMore.message: Your computer’s resolver usually belongs to your internet provider or network, and the lookups travel unencrypted. Encrypted DNS sends them to a resolver you choose instead. Nulavio has no resolver and receives nothing either way.

routingIntroMore.message: Links from other apps (email, chat, documents) and typed addresses follow your rules and open straight in the right profile, before anything loads. Links clicked inside pages follow them only if you turn that on below; you can always right-click a link and choose “Open link in profile”. Rules stay on this computer and only you create them.

aiIntroMore.message: They cannot change these settings. Changes apply to their next action.

assistantIntroMore.message: Nulavio runs no model and has no account: the service is yours (any OpenAI-compatible one, including a model on this computer, or Anthropic). Nothing is sent before you click Send.

passwordsIntroMore.message: With an extension, the browser’s own save and fill prompts turn off, so only one manager offers to fill.

firstrunWelcomeLead.message: You are protected from the start. Everything here can be changed later.

firstrunPasswordsLead.message: Your passwords stay in your password manager: Proton Pass, KeePassXC or Bitwarden (in testing), or the browser’s own. Nulavio never reads your vault.

firstrunDefaultTitle.message: Open links from other apps in Nulavio?

firstrunDefaultLead.message: Links from email, chat and documents would open here, in the right profile once you create routing rules.

firstrunDoneLater.message: You can change any of this in

guardLimit1.message: It notices changes that tools and common malware leave in a profile: extensions, trusted authorities, security modules, programs registered for extensions, managed settings, user.js and settings that protect you.

guardLimit2.message: It cannot stop a program running as you from reading your data, or from also editing Guard’s own record.

guardLimit3.message: In a protected profile, the record stays encrypted while the profile is locked.

assistantSetupTitle.message: Connect the assistant to an AI service

dnsNowDefaultEncrypted.message: Now: the browser's default, with DNS encrypted by Cloudflare (Mozilla's resolver programme).
